reading.title: The Power Cut
reading.text: On Friday evening there was a big storm, and we had a power cut. The whole street went dark, and the power station said it would take two hours to fix. My brother felt powerless because he could not play his game. Dad did everything in his power to make it fun: he lit a candle, and we played cards. Mum told us about wind power, which she has studied at work. She says the sun and wind give us clean energy, and that the power of nature can be safe if we use it wisely. Finally, the lights came back, and we cheered.
